title: Bind the record transfer to the expected Drive record file
evidence: Filed 2026-11-27 from the PR 2226 review: US-09 AC65 confirms the cached record file before the Drive popup reconnect keeps its grant, but when that lookup gives no definite answer the sign-in is kept as before, and the lift then finds its record file by its own discovery (packages/health-core/src/drive-rest-record.ts). Build: carry the expected record file id with the pending transfer, across the reload, and send the device copy only into that file. Needs the engine path. (H427)
